hangzhou-19.bio: Slender seven-storey stone pagoda on Baoshi Hill, one of West Lake's landmarks, with views over the lake.
hangzhou-19.ticket_note: open hill, no single steward site found
hangzhou-19.notes: Free per travel sites only (weak, no official statement); pagoda reopened after restoration 2020 (ehangzhou.gov.cn/2020-04/28/c_269937.htm). Zh Wikipedia: 8-sided 7-tier, 45.3 m. Views claim from Baoshi Hill guides, mark view wording unverified.

hangzhou-38.bio: China's first national-level comic and animation museum, on Baima Lake in Binjiang, with over 20,000 works.
hangzhou-38.ticket_note: booking is via the WeChat public account CCAMuseum; zh Wikipedia lists an official website only as an archived page, not loaded
hangzhou-38.notes: Free, WeChat booking required (zh Wikipedia, ehangzhou). Closed Mon-Tue per sources (not recorded).

jiaxing-5.bio: Jiaxing's city museum, with permanent galleries on the prehistory and history of the Jiaxing area.
jiaxing-5.ticket_note: URL taken from memory of the museum's domain, returned 403 GeoBL from this network; not confirmed it is the museum site; check in a real browser
jiaxing-5.notes: General admission free per China Daily listing (2025); reservation rules unverified. Zh Wikipedia: national first-class museum, 'Hexing Origins' and 'Fertile Jiahe' exhibitions. Domain jxmuseum.cn is unconfirmed.

ningbo-15.bio: Conch-shaped museum of China's ports and underwater archaeology in Beilun, with hands-on halls on harbour technology.
ningbo-15.ticket_note: official site not found; chinaportmuseum.com and similar did not load; check in a browser
ningbo-15.notes: CONFLICT: zh Wikipedia says four main halls are free and only the science-exploration and Digital Ocean halls cost 30 CNY (extras, only Wed/Sat/Sun); China Daily lists general admission 30 CNY. Recorded free per Wikipedia; if China Daily is right use costMin=costMax=30. Needs owner/browser check.

quzhou-6.bio: Quzhou's best-known waterfall, an 88 m horsetail drop in Yaowang Mountain scenic area in Qujiang district.
quzhou-6.ticket_note: no official Yaowang Mountain site found
quzhou-6.notes: COORDINATES WRONG: 40.684,110.873 is in Inner Mongolia, not Quzhou; must be re-resolved (Yaowang Mountain, Huangtankou, Qujiang district). Price: Qunar shows 45 (page) / 65 (search snippet) for Yaowang Mountain ticket, weak. Quzhou policy: Yaowang Mountain free Mon-Fri except holidays (2022) and free for foreign visitors 1 Nov-31 Mar in 2025 initiative; not carried into price. Whether the price covers the waterfall unverified.

yucang-mountain.bio: Forested granite mountain park in Cangnan, said to be the Queen Mother's treasure store, with walking trails and rock carvings.
yucang-mountain.notes: Ctrip: 4A national forest park, listed free with no ticket (an older review says 55 CNY, probably outdated). Gate/open status unverified; costBasis may be entry if staffed. Legend and rock-carving claims from Ctrip review, weak.
